dataset: Zenodo real used battery-electric cars - 2,724 cars (age, odometer, measured health)
inputs: Owner fields only: registration year, odometer, SOC + range shown; health reference = your own earlier readings (or the range when new, if known)
model: Isolation Forest (300 trees, contamination 3%) on age, km per year and health from range
evaluation: 5-fold cross-validation over cars; faults injected into held-out cars

usage_model.features: age, km per year (used on a first check, before a health reference exists)

status_rule.warning: score below the 5th percentile of normal training scores, the dashboard readings disagree by more than 15 %, the full-charge range fell more than 15 % below a reading from the last 90 days, or it declined more than 5 points faster than the ageing model expects since your first reading

limitations: Training health is a measured battery test; the owner's health comes from the dashboard range, which also depends on recent driving, temperature and AC use.
Trained on cars; 2- and 3-wheelers are checked against the same patterns (evidence: limited).
No real fault labels exist, so detection rates come from injected faults.

trip_check.rule: promised full-charge range = range shown at start / SOC at start; delivered = km ridden / SOC used; gap = (promised - delivered) / promised
trip_check.warning: gap 20-35 %, or delivered more than 20 % above promised (unreliable estimate), or 2 of the last 3 trips over 20 %
trip_check.anomalous: gap over 35 %, or 2 of the last 3 trips over 35 %
trip_check.valid_trip: at least 10 % of battery used, same ride mode, no charging
trip_check.calibration: Design thresholds: no public dataset labels battery faults. EV_Predictive_Maintenance_Dataset_15min.csv was checked and rejected (SoC values are random from step to step and unrelated to distance).
